summary: [[character:bill]] watches [[character:riker]] and [[character:homer]] leave for [[location:sol]] alongside a decoy vessel while he and his clone [[character:garfield]] remain. Garfield joins Bill's project-list work, including improvements to [[technology:vr]] and [[technology:artificial-muscle-fiber-analogues]] for realistic robots or androids. Bill regards Garfield as a good partner and worries that Homer's cartoon avatar and incessant Doh's will strain Riker during the journey.

introducing.name: Garfield
introducing.current_state: At [[location:epsilon-eridani]], helping [[character:bill]] begin research-and-development work while declining to participate in building Bobs.

introducing.name: Homer
introducing.current_state: Leaving [[location:epsilon-eridani]] for [[location:sol]] with [[character:riker]]; he uses a cartoon avatar and incessant Doh's.

introducing.name: artificial muscle-fiber analogues
introducing.description: Artificial muscle-fiber analogues are under development for constructing realistic robots or androids.

updates.description: A virtual-reality interface [[character:bob-replicant]] builds aboard [[vessel:heaven-1]] to provide sensory input and an embodied experience while he travels as a bodiless mind. It initially needs hardware modifications and remains an ongoing software project. Planned improvements are intended to support more direct interaction between users.
